Container.Name: PartyLinePager
Container.Overview: Multi-protocol alerting system with Tor, I2P, and Reticulum party lines. Configure via browser terminal or env vars. Supports Telegram, Discord, Matrix, IRC, XMPP, Mastodon, Mattermost, Signal, and Email adapters.

Config.Name: Web Terminal
Config.Description: Browser-based terminal for the setup wizard and management.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent config, state, and secrets.

Config.Name: Providers
Config.Description: Comma-separated transports to enable: tor, i2p, rns, web

Config.Name: Auto Start
Config.Description: Set to 1 to start the daemon automatically on container boot (requires valid config).

Config.Name: Headless Mode
Config.Description: Set to 1 for daemon-only mode with no web terminal (requires valid config).

Config.Name: Terminal Credential
Config.Description: Basic auth for the web terminal (user:password). Strongly recommended.

Config.Name: Telegram Token
Config.Description: Bot token from @BotFather. Enables the Telegram adapter.

Config.Name: Discord Token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

Config.Name: Matrix Homeserver
Config.Description: Matrix homeserver URL (e.g. https://matrix.org).

Config.Name: Matrix User
Config.Description: Matrix username for the bot account.

Config.Name: Matrix Password
Config.Description: Matrix password for the bot account.

Config.Name: IRC Server
Config.Description: IRC server hostname. Enables the IRC adapter.

Config.Name: IRC Port
Config.Description: IRC server port.

Config.Name: IRC Nick
Config.Description: IRC bot nickname.

Config.Name: IRC TLS
Config.Description: Use TLS for IRC connection.

Config.Name: IRC Channel
Config.Description: IRC channel to idle in (e.g. #your-channel).

Config.Name: IRC Account
Config.Description: NickServ account name (if different from nick).

Config.Name: IRC Password
Config.Description: NickServ password for SASL PLAIN auth.

Config.Name: XMPP JID
Config.Description: XMPP JID for the bot account (e.g. bot@xmpp.example.org).

Config.Name: XMPP Password
Config.Description: XMPP account password.

Config.Name: Mastodon Instance
Config.Description: Mastodon instance URL (e.g. https://mastodon.social).

Config.Name: Mastodon Token
Config.Description: Mastodon application token with read:notifications and write:statuses.

Config.Name: Mattermost URL
Config.Description: Mattermost server URL (e.g. https://mattermost.example.org).

Config.Name: Mattermost Token
Config.Description: Mattermost personal or bot access token.

Config.Name: Signal Number
Config.Description: Signal phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15555550100).

Config.Name: Email SMTP Host
Config.Description: SMTP server hostname. Enables the email adapter.

Config.Name: Email SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP server port.

Config.Name: Email SMTP User
Config.Description: SMTP username (often the email address).

Config.Name: Email SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP password.

Config.Name: Email IMAP Host
Config.Description: IMAP server hostname (defaults to SMTP host if blank).

Config.Name: Email From
Config.Description: From address for outgoing email.

Config.Name: Matrix Store Path
Config.Description: Path for Matrix E2EE key store.

Config.Name: Web Base URL
Config.Description: Video call instance URL for web rooms.
